analysis.material: Moulded plastic jar with printed label
analysis.descriptor: a short squat cylindrical jar with rounded shoulders and a gently waisted body, glossy yellow plastic throughout. a wide yellow snap cap with rounded edges sits flush on top, about one quarter of the total height. a white arched label panel on an orange backdrop wraps the upper body, holding a round portrait of a blue skinned deity with a crown and garlands inside an orange ring, ornate scrollwork around it and a curved banner above. a red rectangular band with bold white serif lettering sits below, with a small green dot square at right, then black bold lines beneath. a faint embossed floral pattern rings the base.
